wikibaseimport-desc: Imports entities from another Wikibase, including labels, descriptions, aliases and statements
wikibaseimport-summary: Check one source entity, then import it. Check is a dry-run: it reads the source wiki and does not save anything. Import appears only after a check with no errors. Large batches stay on the importEntities maintenance script. If the local page of an already imported entity was deleted, import creates that same id again and does not restore the archived revision. In import-as-new, a page that still exists is left unchanged. Extend mode updates an existing local entity from a source id you type and does not choose that entity by label or description.
wikibaseimport-operation-new-help: Create a new local entity from the source id. If that source id is already in the mapping table and the local page still exists, it is left unchanged.
wikibaseimport-operation-extend: Extend local Q#/P# by importing additional data from Q#/P# on wikidata.org
wikibaseimport-operation-extend-help: You enter both ids. The local entity is not chosen by label or description, and extend mode does not create an entity.
wikibaseimport-local-entity-description: Existing local id, for example Q10883.
wikibaseimport-replace-description-descr: Off by default. For each language, keep the local description when one exists, and add a description only when that language has none. On: overwrite the local description for every language the source has. A local description in a language the source does not have is kept either way.
wikibaseimport-add-aliases-description: On by default in extend mode. For each language, keep every local alias and append source aliases that are not already present. Comparison is an exact string match in that language. Local aliases are never deleted. Off: leave aliases unchanged.
wikibaseimport-entity-description: One source id, for example Q824909 or P31.
wikibaseimport-user-description: Local account that will own the edits. The field starts from the WBImportUser setting. If that setting is empty, WikibaseImport is used.
wikibaseimport-statements-description: Also copy statements of this entity. Items and properties it points at are created with labels, descriptions and aliases only.
wikibaseimport-sitelinks-description: Keep source sitelinks. Leave this off unless those sites exist in the local sites table.
wikibaseimport-check-ok: Check passed. $1 {{PLURAL:$1|source entity|source entities}} would be saved as $2.
wikibaseimport-check-warn: Check passed with warnings. $1 {{PLURAL:$1|source entity|source entities}} would be saved as $2. Read the log before importing.
wikibaseimport-check-error: Check failed. Nothing was saved. Import stays unavailable until a later check passes.
wikibaseimport-import-ok: Import finished. $1 {{PLURAL:$1|source entity was requested|source entities were requested}}. Edits were saved as $2.
wikibaseimport-import-warn: Import finished with warnings. $1 {{PLURAL:$1|source entity was requested|source entities were requested}}. Edits were saved as $2.
wikibaseimport-import-error: Import finished with errors. Anything saved before the error is already on the wiki. See the log.
wikibaseimport-mode-statements: Statements of the requested entities will be copied.
wikibaseimport-mode-terms: Only labels, descriptions and aliases will be copied.
wikibaseimport-related-count: Related entities in this run: $1. They are properties and items used by the copied statements.
wikibaseimport-mode-mismatch: Import is blocked. The server did not receive the checkbox values. Copy statements: form $2, server $1. Keep sitelinks: form $4, server $3.
wikibaseimport-mode-extend: Extend mode supplements local $1 from source $2. Existing labels are kept.
wikibaseimport-extend-mismatch: Import is blocked. The server did not receive the extend options. Run Check again.
wikibaseimport-bad-id: Enter an item or property id, for example Q10883 or P31.
wikibaseimport-id-mismatch: The local id and the source id must both be items (Q) or both be properties (P).
wikibaseimport-local-missing: Local entity $1 does not exist. Extend mode does not create a new entity.
wikibaseimport-local-redirect: Local entity $1 is a redirect. Extend mode does not follow redirects.
wikibaseimport-source-missing: Source entity $1 was not found on the source wiki.
wikibaseimport-stale: The form changed after the check. Run Check again.
wikibaseimport-hotbox-check-ok: Ready to extend this page from $1.
right-wikibaseimport: Import entities from another Wikibase via Special:WikibaseImport
apihelp-wikibaseimport-summary: Dry-run or import one source entity. Requires the wikibaseimport right.
apihelp-wikibaseimport-param-step: "check" runs a dry-run and saves nothing. "import" writes entities.
apihelp-wikibaseimport-param-entity: Source entity id, for example Q64.
apihelp-wikibaseimport-param-user: Local account that owns the edits. Empty uses the WBImportUser setting, or WikibaseImport when that setting is empty.
apihelp-wikibaseimport-param-statements: 1 copies statements of the requested entity and creates the properties and items they point at. 0 copies labels, descriptions and aliases only.
apihelp-wikibaseimport-param-operation: "new" imports the source as a new local entity. "extend" supplements an existing local entity. The local id is the one you send. It is not guessed from a label or description.
apihelp-wikibaseimport-param-localentity: Local entity id to supplement when operation is extend. Ignored when operation is new.
apihelp-wikibaseimport-param-replacedesc: Used when operation is extend. 1 overwrites the local description for each language the source has. 0 keeps an existing local description and adds one only when that language has none. A local description in a language the source does not have is kept either way.
apihelp-wikibaseimport-param-addaliases: Used when operation is extend. 1 keeps every local alias and adds source aliases that are missing in that language. 0 leaves aliases unchanged.
apihelp-wikibaseimport-example: Dry-run Q64 as PBDBot, including statements.
apihelp-wikibaseimport-example-extend: Dry-run that extends local Q10883 from Wikidata Q501785 (Fairfax) without replacing descriptions.
